opportunities.name: Movie research (IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes) and draft movie-night email
opportunities.description: Look up a movie on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then compose an email to a friend with the movie's director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer, then discard the draft.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open the title page
Note director, runtime and IMDb rating
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open the page
Enter recipient, subject 'Movie night <day>: <movie>' and body with the gathered facts

instances.values: Arrival; lena@example.com; Friday; Denis Villeneuve, 1h 56m, IMDb 7.9, 94%
Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; Hayao Miyazaki, 2h 4m, IMDb 8.6, 96%

opportunities.name: npm package stats note
opportunities.description: Search an npm package, open its page and GitHub repo releases, then save a summary note of version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs
Click through to the GitHub repository and open Releases
Collect version, weekly downloads, license, stars, issues, last release date
Open Notes app and add a note '<package>: ...'

instances.values: express (looked up, not yet noted in the recording)

opportunities.name: Recipe research and note with origin
opportunities.description: Search a recipe on Allrecipes, open the top result, look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings, rating, time, ingredients and origin.
steps: Search the dish on Allrecipes and open the top result
Note rating, time and key ingredients
Add a note '<dish> for N: ... Origin: ...' in Notes

instances.values: shakshuka; Chef John's Shakshuka; origin Ottoman North Africa
pad thai; Pad Thai; origin Thailand

opportunities.name: Cross-check a movie title on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes
opportunities.description: Search a movie title on IMDb and open its page, then search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page.
steps: Search title on IMDb and open the result
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open the result
